function.name: calculate_lcm
function.description: Calculate the least common multiple (lcm) between two integers. Unlike calculate_gcd, which calculates the greatest common divisor (gcd) between two integers, this calculates the least common multiple (lcm) between two integers.

num1.description: First number to calculate lcm for.

num2.description: Second number to calculate lcm for.

function.name: calculate_gcd
function.description: Calculate the greatest common divisor (gcd) between two integers. Unlike calculate_lcm, which calculates the least common multiple (lcm) between two integers, this calculates the greatest common divisor (gcd) between two integers.

num1.description: First number to calculate gcd for.

num2.description: Second number to calculate gcd for.
